collections.name: meeting
collections.label: Meetings
collections.description: CMTE meetings & events. Adding one here automatically updates the home page “Next Meeting” button — it always points at the meeting with the soonest upcoming Meeting Date. See MAINTENANCE.md for the flyer-to-post steps.

fields.name: meeting_date
fields.label: Meeting Date
fields.description: The date of the meeting/event. This drives the home page “Next Meeting” button.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Publish Date
fields.description: When this was posted (controls ordering in the Updates feed).

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Summary Line
fields.description: Shown in the Updates list and under the title — e.g. “(3 CMTE credits) Saturday, March 28, 2026 @ Venue, City, SC”.

fields.name: cmte_credits
fields.label: CMTE Credits
fields.description: Number of credits, e.g. 3. Leave blank if none.

fields.name: registration_url
fields.label: Registration URL
fields.description: The Google Form (or other) sign-up link.

fields.name: flyer
fields.label: Flyer (PDF)
fields.description: Path to the flyer PDF, e.g. /images/your-flyer.pdf

collections.name: post
collections.label: News & Announcements
collections.description: General news and announcements that are NOT meetings (e.g. newsletters). These show up in the Updates feed alongside meetings, sorted by date.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Publish Date
fields.description: Controls ordering in the Updates feed.

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Excerpt
fields.description: Short summary shown in the Updates list.

fields.name: keywords
fields.label: Keywords
fields.description: SEO — optional search terms in the page’s metadata. Safe to leave as-is.

collections.name: therapist
collections.label: Therapists
collections.description: The therapist directory. Each entry becomes one card on the Find a Therapist page. Add, edit, remove, and reorder these freely.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Name, credentials, and city — e.g. “Megan Danelz, MT-BC, NICU-MT Greenville, SC”.

fields.name: website
fields.label: Website URL
fields.description: Full URL including https://

fields.name: weight
fields.label: Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first in the directory.

collections.name: resources
collections.label: Resources
collections.description: Informational pages (About, Membership, Community, FAQ, Helpful Links). Each page picks a Category, which decides where it appears in the Resources sidebar and index.

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Excerpt
fields.description: Short description shown in the resources grid and sidebar.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: PLACEMENT — groups this page in the Resources sidebar and index. Pick from the list; adding a brand-new category requires a developer.

fields.name: weight
fields.label: Order
fields.description: PLACEMENT — lower numbers appear first within a category.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: Only used on the Resources home page; leave blank otherwise.

fields.name: keywords
fields.label: Keywords
fields.description: SEO — optional search terms in the page’s metadata. Most visitors never see these; safe to leave as-is.

collections.name: home
collections.label: Page: Home
collections.description: The front page, built from stackable sections you can reorder or add to. Tip: a button URL of #next-meeting is a magic link that always points to the latest meeting — leave it as-is.

fields.name: sections
fields.label: Page Sections
fields.description: Each section is a block of the page. Drag to reorder. “Section ID” is a technical anchor (no spaces) — only change it if you know why.

fields.name: section_id
fields.label: Section ID
fields.description: Unique anchor id for this section (no spaces).

fields.name: url
fields.label: Button URL
fields.description: Internal path like /find-a-therapist, a full https:// URL, or the special value #next-meeting to auto-link the next meeting.

collections.label: Page: Find a Therapist
collections.description: Only the heading/intro of the Find a Therapist page. The therapist cards themselves come from the Therapists collection.

collections.name: overview
collections.label: Page: Members
collections.description: The Members page heading, image, and call-to-action sections.

fields.name: sections
fields.label: Page Sections
fields.description: The call-to-action blocks shown on the Members page. Drag to reorder.

fields.name: section_id

fields.description: Unique anchor id for this section (no spaces).

collections.name: blog
collections.label: Page: Updates
collections.description: Only the heading/intro of the Updates page. The list of meetings and news below it is generated automatically.

collections.name: page
collections.label: Page: Contact / Dues / Thank-You
collections.description: Heading and intro text for the Contact, Dues, and form Thank-You pages. The contact form and PayPal buttons are built into the site and can’t be edited here.

collections.name: header
collections.label: ⚙️ Settings: Header
collections.description: ADVANCED — affects every page. The site logo and name shown at the top. If you’re not sure, leave this alone or ask a developer.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: The text shown in the top-left of every page (currently “MTASC”). Only used when no logo image is uploaded.

fields.name: logo_img
fields.label: Logo Image
fields.description: Optional. Upload a logo to show in the top-left instead of the Site Name text.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Logo / Title Link
fields.description: Where clicking the logo or site name goes. Almost always “/” (the home page).

fields.name: has_nav
fields.label: Show Navigation Menu
fields.description: Shows the top navigation menu. Leave ON. (The menu items themselves are set in config.yaml, not here.)

collections.name: footer
collections.label: ⚙️ Settings: Footer
collections.description: ADVANCED — affects every page. The footer text and affiliate links (AMTA, SER-AMTA, CBMT).

fields.name: content
fields.label: Footer Text
fields.description: The sentence shown at the bottom of every page, before the affiliate links (e.g. “…is an affiliate organization of”).

fields.name: has_social
fields.label: Show Social Icons
fields.description: Shows the social media icons in the footer (set them under Settings: Social Media).

fields.name: links
fields.label: Footer Links
fields.description: The organization links listed in the footer (AMTA, SER-AMTA, CBMT).

collections.name: social
collections.label: ⚙️ Settings: Social Media
collections.description: ADVANCED — affects every page. The social icons shown in the footer. The Icon Class must be a valid FontAwesome name (e.g. fa-facebook).

fields.name: links
fields.label: Social Accounts
fields.description: Each entry is one icon in the footer. The Icon Class must be a valid FontAwesome brand name (e.g. fa-facebook, fa-instagram) or the icon won’t appear.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon Class
fields.description: FontAwesome brand class, e.g. fa-facebook or fa-instagram.

collections.name: author
collections.label: ⚙️ Settings: Author
collections.description: ADVANCED — site metadata used in the page <head> (author name/email). Rarely needs changing.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Used in the hidden “author” metadata tag in each page’s HTML. Not shown on the site.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.description: Optional metadata. Not displayed on the site.

fields.name: avatar
fields.label: Avatar
fields.description: Optional metadata image. Not currently shown on the site.
